items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 248:1
items.html: The participation of the quality of judgment together with the quality of mercy, which was made in the second restriction, is the participation of the Serpent [Shitufa de-Tanina]. And in the future, at the completion of the correction, the second restriction will then be abolished and the world will return to its former state, to the aspect of AK, which is the first restriction. And so in AA, which is the stature of AB, the second restriction is not discernible in him, and there is no participation of the Serpent in him. And this is the secret of what is said of the completion of the correction: "See now that I, even I, am He, and there is no god with Me," and the Zohar interprets it as meaning that there is no participation in Him. For then the world will return to the degree of the first restriction, without the participation of the quality of mercy in judgment. (Item 18).
